metadata.methods_description: The main dataset was recorded with a 64-channel EEG system (10-20 layout; 60 channels used) at 1000 Hz raw and 250 Hz processed. Each trial had a 2 s cue period, a 4 s task period, and a 4 s rest period. Paradigms were Graz motor imagery, SSMVEP-MI, and hybrid video conditions. The supplementary space station data were recorded with a 32-channel dry-electrode EEGO system and stored as MATLAB .mat files.

citation_details.title: Cross-Environment Multi-Paradigm Motor Imagery EEG Dataset
citation_details.author: Sun Xinwei, Wang Kun, Lincong Pan, Cao Yupei, Meng Lin
citation_details.abstract: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 84 healthy participants performing motor imagery tasks across multiple controlled environments (laboratory and simulated hospital), with a supplementary cohort of 3 participants recorded in microgravity conditions in a space station environment. The dataset includes multiple motor imagery paradigms (Graz, SSMVEP-MI, and hybrid variants) with 64-channel EEG recordings at 1000 Hz sampling rate (69 channels acquired, 60 channels used in analysis), designed to investigate environmental effects on brain-computer interface performance and enable cross-environment robustness evaluation. This dataset is a republication of OpenNeuro ds007221 on the NEMAR platform to enhance accessibility and discoverability within the neuroimaging research community.
